core.title: 4-1/2 x 4-1/2 Stainless Electric Hinge, Bommer BB5062-450-ETW04-630

text.description_html:
4-1/2 x 4-1/2 Stainless Steel Electric Hinge

Standard commercial size (2) ball bearing stainless steel 4 wire electric door hinge. Standard duty door hinge, .136" thickness, standard full mortise hinge with 5 knuckle design and button tips. BHMA certified architectural grade hinges. Made in the USA.

Specifications: for Bommer BB5062-450-ETW04-630

  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 4-1/2"
  • Corners: Square
  • 2 Ball Bearings for Smooth Action
  • Thickness: 0.136" (Standard Duty)
  • 12" Wire Leads Per Side
  • Four (4) 28 Gauge Wires
  • Hinge Material: Stainless Steel
  • Wood Screws: #12 x 1-1/4"
  • Machine Screws: #12-24 x 1/2"
  • BHMA Certified Hinge
  • Non-Handed
  • NON-REMOVABLE BUTTON TIP PIN & PLUG
  • MOUNT IN CENTER POSITION ONLY
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel

Package with matching finish machine screws and wood screws. For use with both metal and wood doors.

*Sold Individually (1 door hinge)
